name_en: Agemaki Yuba no Nimono — rolled, fried yuba simmered in a light broth, from Nikko
summary_ja: 生ゆばを重ねて棒状に巻き、輪切りにして油で揚げた「揚げまき湯波」を、薄味でじっくり煮た日光の郷土料理。表面が波打つ日光ゆばの技法を生かし、正月や祝いの席にも欠かせない。
summary_en: Fresh yuba sheets are layered, rolled into a log, sliced into rounds, and deep-fried before a slow simmer in a light broth — a Nikko dish built on the region's rippled yuba-making craft, served at New Year's and celebrations.
source_title: 揚げまき湯波の煮物 栃木県
